title: เลือกทิศทางภาพของหน้าถอดเสียง
question: เลือกทิศทางที่อยากให้หน้าเครื่องมือใช้ หรือขอไพ่ชุดใหม่ได้

options.label: The Field Record
options.thesis: A recording stays readable because each passage is anchored to a precise time mark.
options.viewport: A familiar workspace: local file and player on the left, transcript segments on the right, a narrow red margin bracket following the active timestamp.
options.risk: The notebook world can imply editing or permanent notes; the transcript remains read-only and session-bound.

raised.raise: The sheet uses a disciplined modular grid, while transcript rows keep generous line spacing.

options.label: The Time Route
options.lineage: public wayfinding maps and route diagrams
options.thesis: The transcript is a route through the clip; the current segment is the stop where playback stands.
options.viewport: The player and transcript remain standard work areas; a colored time rail joins transcript segments and its active stop moves with playback.
options.risk: A map can overstate the metaphor; keep the route to one margin rail so transcript text stays primary.

options.label: The Time Atlas
options.thesis: A clip becomes a field of time coordinates, with the current segment marked precisely.
options.viewport: A familiar player and transcript list lead; a narrow time-coordinate rail maps the active timestamp beside the current segment.
options.risk: Constellation language can pull attention away from everyday transcript reading.
options.case: A precise time position maps well to transcript segments; weaker audience identification than the field-record system.

options.label: The Live Schedule
options.lineage: boarding passes and live departure boards
options.thesis: The current processing state stays visible while a clip moves from upload to transcript.
options.viewport: The file and service state lead the page; player and transcript occupy distinct work areas below, with state changes held in place.
options.risk: Travel cues do not belong to every clip; use the durable status-row behavior without flight language or scannable pass decoration.
options.case: Clear queue and status handling; weaker audience identification because the travel context is incidental.

options.label: The Concourse Board
options.thesis: Processing and playback each have a state that changes in place and stays easy to spot.
options.viewport: The familiar player/transcript layout stays intact; a compact status row holds queued, processing, and complete states above it.
options.risk: Literal flipping motion would distract from reading; keep the row identity and state contrast, with reduced motion respected.
options.case: Excellent state persistence and scanability; weaker than the route on tying each transcript segment to playback time.

options.label: Dense Modular Index
options.thesis: Every part of the file and transcript is visible in a tightly packed grid.
options.viewport: A standard workbench uses a strict grid but preserves a readable player and spacious transcript segments.
options.risk: High density and tiny labels undermine long-form Thai transcript readability.
options.kept: A disciplined modular grid and thin dividers that make relationships clear.

options.label: Garden Map
options.thesis: Each work area becomes a distinct territory joined by the clip's timeline.
options.viewport: Player and transcript stay recognizable as separate work areas; a small marker follows the active segment.
options.risk: Oversized shapes and overshooting motion pull attention away from the text and controls.
options.kept: A strong color boundary between work areas, without the lobe-shaped layout.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.thesis: One selected segment becomes the visual focal point of a nearly unprinted field.
options.viewport: A clear media area and readable transcript remain present; the active segment receives one strong plotted mark.
options.risk: Encoded labels and very sparse content make file, status, and transcript controls harder to discover.
options.kept: A single focal marker that makes the current segment unmistakable.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished file picker, status message, player, and transcript with conventional neutral styling.
canonCard.viewport: File selection sits above a two-column player and transcript workspace, with plain status and download actions.
canonCard.risk: Clear and familiar, but offers little identity beyond a typical transcription utility.
